test.create_query: CREATE TABLE test_u64_left_{card} (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE test_u64_right_{card} (k UInt64, payload UInt64, text String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO test_u64_left_{card} SELECT number % {card} FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
INSERT INTO test_u64_right_{card} SELECT number, number + 1, toString(number) FROM numbers({card})
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE pmj_u64_sparse_right (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO pmj_u64_sparse_right SELECT number * 100 FROM numbers(10000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE pmj_u64_mult2 (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE pmj_u64_mult3 (k UInt64, payload UInt64, text String, label LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO pmj_u64_mult2 SELECT number * 2 FROM numbers_mt(8000000)
INSERT INTO pmj_u64_mult3 SELECT number * 3, number * 3 + 1, toString(number * 3), toLowCardinality(toString(number % 1000)) FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE pmj_u64_crossover_right (k UInt64, payload UInt64, text String, label LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO pmj_u64_crossover_right SELECT number, number + 1, toString(number), toLowCardinality(toString(number % 1000)) FROM numbers(1000000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE pmj_u64_crossover_left_{unmatched_run} (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO pmj_u64_crossover_left_{unmatched_run} SELECT number FROM numbers(1000000) WHERE number % ({unmatched_run} + 1) = 0
test.query: SELECT count() FROM test_u64_left_{card} AS a JOIN test_u64_right_{card} AS b ON a.k = b.k FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'partial_merge'
SELECT count() FROM test_u64_left_1000000 AS a JOIN pmj_u64_sparse_right AS b ON a.k = b.k FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'partial_merge'
SELECT count() FROM pmj_u64_mult2 AS a JOIN pmj_u64_mult3 AS b ON a.k = b.k FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'partial_merge'

SELECT count(), sum(b.k), sum(b.payload), sum(length(b.text)), sum(length(b.label)) FROM pmj_u64_mult2 AS a ALL RIGHT JOIN pmj_u64_mult3 AS b ON a.k = b.k FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'partial_merge'

SELECT count(), sum(b.k), sum(b.payload), sum(length(b.text)) FROM pmj_u64_sparse_right AS a ALL RIGHT JOIN test_u64_right_1000000 AS b ON a.k = b.k FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'partial_merge'

SELECT count(), sum(b.k), sum(b.payload), sum(length(b.text)) FROM pmj_u64_sparse_right AS a ALL FULL JOIN test_u64_right_1000000 AS b ON a.k = b.k FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'partial_merge'

SELECT count(), sum(b.k), sum(b.payload), sum(length(b.text)), sum(length(b.label)) FROM pmj_u64_crossover_left_{unmatched_run} AS a ALL RIGHT JOIN pmj_u64_crossover_right AS b ON a.k = b.k FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'partial_merge', partial_merge_join_rows_in_right_blocks = 65536, max_threads = 1
